sloka: गुणा बहु विधाः प्राप्ताः तव संदर्शनात् मया ।विस्तरेण च वै ब्रह्मन् कीर्त्यमानम् महत्तपः ॥१-६५-३३॥
transliteration: guṇā bahu vidhāḥ prāptāḥ tava saṁdarśanāt mayā ।vistareṇa ca vai brahman kīrtyamānam mahattapaḥ ॥1-65-33॥

translations.english: O powerful Brahmarshi distinguished Rama and I have heard your great austerities which were related in detail (by Satananda).
